description_for_human: Nightly Combo A options dataset (Mid >= $1.00, OI >= 500, Delta 0.22–0.48, DTE 10–45), 10-minute intraday liquidity snapshots, and 3-day excursion outcome history over MCP. Free 3-contract preview; Pro full dataset at $299/yr or $29/mo founding price (7-day free trial).
description_for_model: GammaRips serves the nightly Combo A options dataset, 10-minute intraday liquidity snapshots, and 3-day excursion outcome surfaces to AI agents over 9 MCP tools. Every trading night at 23:00 ET it scans ~3,500 optionable US stocks, filters to the top 100 liquid universe (3M+ session shares, 25+ listed strikes), and selects one out-of-the-money call per bullish name passing the Combo A microstructure and convexity gates (Mid >= $1.00, OI >= 500, Delta 0.22–0.48, DTE 10–45), enriched at 05:30 ET with Realized-vs-Implied Volatility (rv_iv_ratio), technicals, flow context, and grounded news catalysts. Validated in Catalyst Lab walk-forward audits (N = 5,575 contracts across 66 scan dates): resting OI >= 500 lifts 5-minute fast execution fills from 30.3% to 50.1%, Delta 0.22–0.48 + DTE 10–45 lifts 3-day MFE >= +40% from 27.6% to 35.4%, and rv_iv_ratio >= 0.85 is the #1 quantitative predictor of favorable 3-day excursions. get_pool serves the dataset (view=preview returns the free 3-contract preview matching https://gammarips.com/signals; view=enriched, raw, or features returns the full 40–50 contract pool on Pro). get_signal provides per-ticker deep dives (view=detail) and earnings-window checks (view=earnings). get_liquidity returns 10-minute intraday liquidity snapshots (09:02–16:52 ET). query_outcomes queries BigQuery enriched_option_outcomes (touch-probability curves via view=harvest, 3-day MFE/MAE excursion surfaces via view=surface, and bracket scoring via view=exit_rule). replay_contract returns minute or daily option price bars. get_regime_context, get_market_calendar_status, get_playbook, and get_daily_report are free reference tools. There is NO shared pick endpoint. Start with get_playbook(name='start-here'). Auth: OAuth 2.1 sign-in at https://mcp.gammarips.com/pro or 'Authorization: Bearer gr_live_...' API key generated at https://gammarips.com/account (subscription at https://gammarips.com/pricing, $299/yr or $29/mo founding price for the first 100 subscribers, $39/mo after, 7-day free trial). Educational only. Not investment advice.
